ReactServer > has Owner Stacks in DEV wh.note: Renders with ReactNoopServer. In the jest setup, react-server is shimmed with the noop config object, which has no supportsClientAPIs field, so Fizz uses its renderToHTML dispatcher: useState throws "Cannot use state or effect Hooks in renderToHTML..." there, and so does use(store), by design (DECISIONS: stores throw where nothing is hydrated). The built fork (ReactFizzConfig.custom.js) sets supportsClientAPIs = true, so this is a jest-only gap; passing supportsClientAPIs: true in ReactNoopServer's config would make the case translatable.
